[quote=astanir;60402247][spoiler]Despite the increasing stubbornness of the tribes towards each other, the Nordiheimian would be able to gather the following information:
[list]
- The four major tribes (including the Sui-mana) of the main island had all settled on the island separately hundreds of years earlier.
- They had all moved to Astanir to escape a phenomenon on the east Argossian mainland known as the great evil, yet nobody knows what this evil was, as it has since been lost to time.
- After settlement, several territorial issues arose which have stuck around to the modern day. During times of high tension, several wars even broke out between the tribes, along with already ongoing wars against the shamatine astanirans.
- The stories told by the different tribes had been all been bent in their individual favour over hundreds of years.
[/list]

Despite these issues, the good news brought by the Nordiheimians would be enough to temporarily rope the tribes back into negotiations. Additionally, the Sui-mana have requested that Nordiheim allow their representatives to attend negotiations too, by airlifting them out of the combat zone.

Additionally, the bad news would help empower the tribes to work together again, towards their common enemy.

On the lower islands, the multiple revolts would rapidly escalate and spread. Being cut off from their supplies by the Nordiheimians would cause the junta forces to be worn down quickly. Within a week, the entirety of the islands would be under the control of one Nordiheimian backed militia or another.

As operation sky serpent continued, the sui-mana would continue to push forward on all fronts. The heavier weapons provided would allow them to make a major offensive of the junta territory to the east of them, completely seizing multiple towns and strongholds. However, they wouldnt stop. As they continued to march on against the junta and the nationalists, they would also make an incursion into democratic territory, making no distinction between them and the other shamatine factions. This would be the biggest mistake of the war so far ([nation]Qianxun[/nation])

Whilst the Nordiheimians were undoubtedly providing a huge help to the argossians, they would not go unnoticed. The first hint would come to the restorationist/junta forces when Nordiheim made the decision to move ships into a prime supply route between the stronghold island and the main island. The high concentration of radar on the stronghold would detect a faint trace of the Nordiheimians, but wouldnt be powerfully enough to confirm, so when they sent the next supply run out, they would pack it full of radar in addition to submarine escorts which would survey from below. They would be careful to stay well away from the Nordiheimians, just enough to detect them. Upon receiving the data, the stronghold island would begin preparing a task force to confront the Nordiheimians.

In addition to this, battle reports from the Sui-mana enclave and the lower islands would reveal a clear picture to the junta forces. Nordiheim must be stopped.[/spoiler][/quote]

[quote=astanir;60414603][spoiler]Many many objections would arise at the cancellation of negotiations and the detention of the leaders of the factions that had attended. Guoing Loka of the Amarallo peoples army would simply follow whatever the pantagruelis said, knowing that cooperation with them would be vital to the survival of his faction, despite the fact that Pantagruel had in some ways betrayed them, by invading and seizing the islands. The Democrats and tribal leaders however, would be less than cooperative.

Haru arono, now representing the splinter free Astaniran front after the Kuwalkti incident, would at first object loudly against being kept in pantagruel. He is known for fighting alongside his men in the frontlines, not just sitting back like every other leader. Eventually, he would quieten down, realising that his objections would do nothing, but he would be sure to never cooperate with the pantagruelis, suspecting they would try to take advantage of the dire situation in his homeland, just as Qianxun had.

The tribal leaders would also be stubborn, yet less vocal about their objections. After they received intelligence from Nordiheim before they left for Teremok, they would place a deep mistrust in Pantagruel, fearing that they would be the same as Qianxun, just like Haru.

None of the tribal leaders would agree to sign into the UDF, placing a roadblock in Pantagruels path. However, The peoples army would quickly give in to Pantagruels demands, knowing that this would be the only way to save their split and crumbling faction. This would allow the UDF to successfully form as a reformation of the APA, but no tribal cooperation would ensue. The tribal leaders would vow to die rather than sign into the UDF.

With the tribal militias still retaining independence from the confederacy, the UDF and PDF would most likely have a much harder time executing their plans, but if the lilypad offensive still went ahead, the following events would follow:

[i]
Pantagrueli intelligence would be outdated as of the date of the offensive. Within recent days, the lower islands had been successfully captured by tribal forces, driving the restorationists back into their stronghold island and their mainland territory. This would result in the operation accidentally targeting the tribal militias, instead of the restorationists, yet the UDF would be able to make no distinction between the two until it was too late, and the operation would therefore continue.

The amphibious assault would largely go undetected, until the point when the UDF would fire. As Nordiheimian-provided naval ships made routine surveillance routes around the islands, they would be detected by Pantagruels radar devices and subsequently fired upon as the ships approached the UDFs location, unaware of the hidden force. With 1 ship hit, the command centres back on the islands would be notified of the situation. Additionally, requests for assistance would be sent directly to Nordiheim. The lower amount of anti-air and naval equipment provided to the lower islands would lead to them using naval forces simply to buy time, whilst they waited for Nordiheim to arrive. On the island, troops and battle tanks would be readied on the coastline in preparation for the assault that would come.

The missiles launched would reach their targets on the tribal-inhabited lower islands with little resistance. The lack of anti-air systems provided by Nordiheim would allow the missiles to hit all targets successfully, crippling the islands infrastructure, yet also crippling the UDFs chance of cooperating with the tribes.

The aardvarks would further pummel the tribal population and infrastructure as there would be no effective counter to the guided munitions.

As the amphibious landing began, the tribes could only pray that the Nordiheimians would receive their call for help, whilst standing their ground and buying time for the Nordiheimian navy. The drake 2D battle tanks would roll onto the beaches to take on the UDF, whilst machine gunners and snipers would take aim from behind.  Whilst this unfolded, troops would continue to be diverted from around the islands to the various amphibious landing sites.

Now it would simply be a waiting game
[/i]

[spoiler=Confusion causes escalation!][b][u]Astanir mainland:[/u][/b]
Whit the Argossian tribes brought back to the table ones more the Nordiheimians could breath a sigh of relife (for now), but it did not mean that their work was done when it came to getting the tribes to stay together.
While some information had been found about their history and past issues more investigation would have to continue, though the diplomatic agents could start their work with what had been found so far to try and find common ground and compromises that all the tribes could potentialy live with, somting that could provide an important start to build future trust upon.

An air mission was also launched to allow the Sui-mana tribe to have people physicaly attend the negotiations, a small, fast and agile aricraft was chosen for the jobb to as it would be much harder to detect and target, this aircraft had also been modefied to have a smaller signature then it would normaly have aswell as having flares and chaff launchers installed joust incase.
The mission would be monitored by 2 stealth observation UAVs and several wings of KJ-6G Kookaburra would be ready within range to defend it should it be needed, in addition the plane would fly a westward path with the least amount of enemy presence, based on information from the many infiltrators that Nordiheim had in the general area to further reduce the chance of detection, out to the ocean and then up north to the main Argossian area to avoid the active front lines.

The deliveries of material to the main Argossian area would also be given some better weapon systems, since the Democratic faction had been basicly taken over by a outside force it was not unlikely that they would be given aircraft to try and take sky dominance, and the Astanir National Forces could not be expected to not make a try at claiming the sky for the benefits that it could bring them in the conflict.
As such AA systems would be suplied to them;
Kangaroo MAMIVs with AAAMS-2B Valkyrie AA systems for short range protection, a bunch of the old but reliable Karlson 85MPT trucks with some of them being equiped with a mix of AAAMS-3A Shield maiden and Dual 105mm L/52 AA Module for medium range defence together with some Tyr-1 Automatic AA modules for missile point defence, all of them nice and mobile.
The few airfields that the Argossian militias had would also be prepped to be able to be used by KJ-5H Cockatoo fighters, these aircraft might be old but they had been heavily modernized to function as air interseptors that could target aircraft and missiles to contest the sky, the tribes were aproched to find out who of their people could be taken in to be trained in their use and if they would accept "volunteers", from the Argossian tribes in Nordiheim, to fly them while their own were trained.

The central enclave of Sui-mana would also not be forgoten, while it might be difficult to provide them with these heavier AA system there was one that could easely be air droped to them and used, the SA-10 AXS is a heavier infantry AA missile launcher that need 2 men to operate unlike the lighter SA-7 AXS but it have much longer range and is much more dangerous, this would hopefully provide them with a way of denying local enemies total air superiorety unless they desired to take on the losses of doing so.

Hopefully this would prove usefull in for the Argossian Militias on mainland Astanir.

[b][u]The island stronghold of the Armed Restoration Front:[/u][/b]

Nordiheim would manage to more or less figure out what the Armed restoration front was up to trough a mix of different sources and mettods;
>Their infiltrators would notefy them of the faction preparing some sort of naval task force for someting.
>The comunications that was intercepted by the Nordiheimians made it obvious that not only were they suspicious of the ships in the waters between their island and the Astanir mainland but they proberly knew that someone was obviusly helping the Argossian militias.
>And lastly their radar search for them with their supply run was rather obvios as their radar made them light up like a chrismass tree to the much more advanced Nordiheimian system.
This made it painfully obvious that they were planing to do someting, but what exactly were not entierly known, but Nordiheim comand decided to play the situation with a carefull hand joust in case as while the Armed restoration fronts equipment might be older then theirs it could still be dangerous if they had anyone competent comanding it while they underrestimated them in return.

The local ships would be gathered in two fleets;
>The small fleet (1 destroyers, 2 frigates, 1 cutter and 3 patrol boats defending) the COMINT ship as it performet its task would be reinforced with 1 of the Fenrir battleships in adition to 1 Sleipnir-Class Frigate to provide it with extra submarine defences pluss 1 cruise, 1 destroyer and 1 cutter, they would go into code yellow with submarine defences active and AA systems ready to go if any missiles would start comming towards them.
One wolf pack of 2 attack submarines would also stalk the waters bellow aswell.

>The rest of the ships would form a larger fleet with the 2 other battles ships together with 1 cruiser, 3 destroyers, 3 frigates, 3 cutters and 5 patroll boats, with a wolf pack of 2 attack submarines also stalking the waters bellow them to.
This fleet would be at standby to see how tings developed.

Lastly 2 stealth UAVs would be sendt to monitor the situation, 1 in the airspace of the island and one over the waters between the island and the smaller fleet with the COMINT ship.
The 12 stealth jets of Nordiheim, all that they had at this point, would all be stationed on military base on the small Nordiheim island that was closest to all of this joust in case together with other UAVs (2 stealth ones) and airplanes that might become necesary.

The submarines in Nordiheims home waters was also put in ready mode incase they would be so brash as try someting in that direction, tough this was more a protocol move.

If they were going to directly engage them it would be a foolish move by them, on the other hand if the Armed restoration front ended up joust doing a stand-off with them and look angrily at them it would ironicly be to their advantage as it would limmit the intell that Nordiheim could provide to the Argossian militias over time as they had been using their navy to do some of it, and sending more AWAC airplanes would actualy be somewhat difficult without weakening Nordiheims home defences, pealing away ships in suchh a situation wouldn't be ideal either.
As such Nordiheim comand hoped they didn't have someone in comand that could tink of such a ting.

[b][u]The attack on the two lower islands and a somewhat violent response:[/u][/b]

The detection of a unkown invasion fleet and its subseqvent attack on the Argossians on the islands would do noting but further complicate tings as it wasen't exactly expected even if they managed to detect them before they made landfall, the messages from the Argossians were noting more then redundant confirmation of what had joust unfolded.
Though identifying this fleet and the faction that it belonged to was much harder, they brandished a faction insignia that was compleatly unkown to the Nordiheimian HQ and seemed to use a inventory of weapons and vehicles that also was mostly unkown to them from what they could gather from fragmented intell that they coulden't trully trust, but it did not seem to be from Astanir.

It was swiftly desided that the attack from this unknown faction could not be accepted and seen as the direct invasion from a foreign nation on another nations land ((trough missunderstnading and not knowing who they actualy were)).

As such Nordiheim would launch "Operation Walanari" wich would consist of the following moves;
>The larger fleet with 2 battleships would move to place themselfs between the two lower islands and the direction that the invasion fleet seemed to have come from with operation code red, were all weapons and defences active and ready to go at a moments notice, both to treathen the invasion fleet with the battleships long range anti-ship missle payload (they curently have anti-ship missiles in 10 of their 15 VLS tubes) and to pose a problem for any logistics ships that is going to this hostile fleet.
>The 2 stealth UAVs would take to the air and start providing information and air targets for attacks.
>The 15 stealth fighters would form 5 wings of 3 aircraft each and use their advanced missile systems and stealth to pick apart any hostile aircrafts or missiles in the airzone of the two islands.
>The 3 Njord-Class Cruise missile Submarines together with launch sites in eastern Ostland would launch a barage of long range anti-ship cruise missiles, numbering about a hundred, at the invaiding fleet to get all of them away from the western side of the islands to clear a path for sending suplies.

>Then the  Argosian tribes there would be supplied with anit-air defences on the smaller island trough quick deliveries by Airheim SHH1-1C Sky Leviatan helicopter that would be guarded by Fighter escorts and stealth attack helicopers to prevent them from being shot down, these would bring in enough weapon systems to make 5 small mobile SAM teams were each would contain: 2x AAHAML-41 Module on Karlson 95MPT trucks, 5x AAAMS-3A Shield maidens on Karlson 85MPT truck with aditional mobile point defence systems to protect them together with "advisors" that would help the Argossians use the AA weapons effectivly.
There would also be sent Kangaroos with the  AAAMS-2B Valkyrie AA system and AC-4B AA2s to provide mobile AA defence for local forces, together with more weapons, vehilces and munitions to the Argossian defenders to replenish their losses including some more Iron Drake 2D tanks with ERA bricks for added protection.

Inn addition the stealth corvetes in Ostland and Nordland, aswell as the local attack submarines would be sendt to the small Nordiheimian island closest to all of this to provide defence for future events and operations.

The Nordiheimian could not only hope that this was all enough to save the Argossians on the two small islands from this hostile invasion and make the neceseary preparations to not only do further operations but most likely also to provide the local civilians with food, water and medical suplies as those were tings that would often get disrupted in a invasion and could turn out to be necesary.
[/spoiler]

[Spoiler=A Raid on Guhui'Bernardio Gun Smugglers]
[b]A Few Days Ago[/b]

The Directorate of Intelligence had been staking out their target, a safehouse suspected to be used by gun smugglers for Hatzur Zatsugi's Guhui'Bernardio, for weeks. They had caught arms smugglers on the border who had been bringing weaponry from the old territory of Sal Baliz follow its collapse. After some intense interrogation and following up on leads, they had prepared to strike and capture as many smugglers and illicit weaponry as possible.

Eventually, officers of the DI encircle the building, an industrial warehouse near the port of Shar, ostensibly leased to a plastics manufacturer but which was being used as a front for money laundering. When the order is given, they burst through every door, weapons pointed, shouting at everyone to get down.

The smugglers are caught unaware and immediately jump for cover using whatever weapons they can quickly grab. After a brief gun fight, three smugglers are killed and six captured.

[B]Now[/b]

President Fereydun Khan walks up to the podium before the industrial site before a selected group of journalists for Dhornaper's largest news agencies. He stands at the podium, waits for a moment, and then begins speaking:

"A few days ago, the DI launched a raid on this industrial site targeting gun smugglers. These gun smugglers had been bringing in weaponry from Sal Baliz following the collapse of their Caliphate and selling it to members of Guhui'Bernardio. We have captured several of the smugglers and are hunting down the rest and their partners in crime, the followers of Hatzur Zatsugi. Effectively immediately, Guhui'Bernardio is designated as a terrorist group and the police and DI have enhanced powers to track down and root out their members from Dhornaper. We are also hunting down Hatzur Zatsugi and will work with other countries who are also trying to uproot his criminal empire and terrorist group."
[/spoiler]

[i]The warships now appeared on the radar of the gliding F-15s. Their decision to attack the smaller gunboats had been foolish; survivors were able to relay their positions into the F-15s' data systems. The aircraft began a full-scale process of computing and translating that data into coordinates, which were passed to local surveillance drones loitering kilometeters above the battlefield. The drones correlated mapped infrared and radar returns across the maritime canvas, confirmed the ships' positions, and relayed the information back to the F-15s. With full awareness of the new targets, the F-15s initiated a counterattack to shift the tempo of the battle. Their AGM-158C LRASMs provided an ideal solution. The missiles separated from the aircraft, glided away until they reached a safe distance from the F-15s, then ignited their motors and streaked toward the naval targets.

With Tribal defenses softened, the UDF advanced toward their objective, but each gain stretched their lines. Guerrilla tactics and sniper ambushes forced UDF forces to fall back to central rallying points where they could better engage the more sophisticated tribal units. The attacking squadrons noticed that tribal tanks concentrated on defending checkpoints, so they used small loitering drones to locate those clusters. The drones then guided 9M117 Bastion anti-armor missiles into the Tribal terrain until the missiles found their targets.

When tribal forces proved unwilling to negotiate, the UDF shifted to a policy of total annihilation, employing all available means to neutralize resistance. Occupation forces observed that Argossian tribes continued to fight after missile strikes and bombings, so they called in another squadron of Aardvarks to finish destroying the positions. Information flowed carefully between units as Aardvarks lifted from airstrips across the southern archipelago and screamed toward tribal forces with an even heavier payload aimed at eliminating the remaining resistance.

There was to be no waiting, the UDF knew taking the initiative was key in ending the tribes as soon as possible. [/i]

Kangaroo MAMIVs with AAAMS-2B Valkyrie AA systems for short range protection, a bunch of the old but reliable Karlson 85MPT trucks with some of them being equiped with a mix of AAAMS-3A Shield maiden and Dual 105mm L/52 AA Module for medium range defence together with some Tyr-1 Automatic AA modules for missile point defence, all of them nice and mobile.
The few airfields that the Argossian militias had would also be prepped to be able to be used by KJ-5H Cockatoo fighters, these aircraft might be old but they had been heavily modernized to function as air interseptors that could target aircraft and missiles to contest the sky, the tribes were aproched to find out who of their people could be taken in to be trained in their use and if they would accept "volunteers", from the Argossian tribes in Nordiheim, to fly them while their own were trained.

The central enclave of Sui-mana would also not be forgoten, while it might be difficult to provide them with these heavier AA system there was one that could easely be air droped to them and used, the SA-10 AXS is a heavier infantry AA missile launcher that need 2 men to operate unlike the lighter SA-7 AXS but it have much longer range and is much more dangerous, this would hopefully provide them with a way of denying local enemies total air superiorety unless they desired to take on the losses of doing so.

Hopefully this would prove usefull in for the Argossian Militias on mainland Astanir.

[b][u]The island stronghold of the Armed Restoration Front:[/u][/b]

Nordiheim would manage to more or less figure out what the Armed restoration front was up to trough a mix of different sources and mettods;
>Their infiltrators would notefy them of the faction preparing some sort of naval task force for someting.
>The comunications that was intercepted by the Nordiheimians made it obvious that not only were they suspicious of the ships in the waters between their island and the Astanir mainland but they proberly knew that someone was obviusly helping the Argossian militias.
>And lastly their radar search for them with their supply run was rather obvios as their radar made them light up like a chrismass tree to the much more advanced Nordiheimian system.
This made it painfully obvious that they were planing to do someting, but what exactly were not entierly known, but Nordiheim comand decided to play the situation with a carefull hand joust in case as while the Armed restoration fronts equipment might be older then theirs it could still be dangerous if they had anyone competent comanding it while they underrestimated them in return.

The local ships would be gathered in two fleets;
>The small fleet (1 destroyers, 2 frigates, 1 cutter and 3 patrol boats defending) the COMINT ship as it performet its task would be reinforced with 1 of the Fenrir battleships in adition to 1 Sleipnir-Class Frigate to provide it with extra submarine defences pluss 1 cruise, 1 destroyer and 1 cutter, they would go into code yellow with submarine defences active and AA systems ready to go if any missiles would start comming towards them.
One wolf pack of 2 attack submarines would also stalk the waters bellow aswell.

>The rest of the ships would form a larger fleet with the 2 other battles ships together with 1 cruiser, 3 destroyers, 3 frigates, 3 cutters and 5 patroll boats, with a wolf pack of 2 attack submarines also stalking the waters bellow them to.
This fleet would be at standby to see how tings developed.

Lastly 2 stealth UAVs would be sendt to monitor the situation, 1 in the airspace of the island and one over the waters between the island and the smaller fleet with the COMINT ship.
The 12 stealth jets of Nordiheim, all that they had at this point, would all be stationed on military base on the small Nordiheim island that was closest to all of this joust in case together with other UAVs (2 stealth ones) and airplanes that might become necesary.

The submarines in Nordiheims home waters was also put in ready mode incase they would be so brash as try someting in that direction, tough this was more a protocol move.

If they were going to directly engage them it would be a foolish move by them, on the other hand if the Armed restoration front ended up joust doing a stand-off with them and look angrily at them it would ironicly be to their advantage as it would limmit the intell that Nordiheim could provide to the Argossian militias over time as they had been using their navy to do some of it, and sending more AWAC airplanes would actualy be somewhat difficult without weakening Nordiheims home defences, pealing away ships in suchh a situation wouldn't be ideal either.
As such Nordiheim comand hoped they didn't have someone in comand that could tink of such a ting.

[b][u]The attack on the two lower islands and a somewhat violent response:[/u][/b]

The detection of a unkown invasion fleet and its subseqvent attack on the Argossians on the islands would do noting but further complicate tings as it wasen't exactly expected even if they managed to detect them before they made landfall, the messages from the Argossians were noting more then redundant confirmation of what had joust unfolded.
Though identifying this fleet and the faction that it belonged to was much harder, they brandished a faction insignia that was compleatly unkown to the Nordiheimian HQ and seemed to use a inventory of weapons and vehicles that also was mostly unkown to them from what they could gather from fragmented intell that they coulden't trully trust, but it did not seem to be from Astanir.

It was swiftly desided that the attack from this unknown faction could not be accepted and seen as the direct invasion from a foreign nation on another nations land ((trough missunderstnading and not knowing who they actualy were)).

As such Nordiheim would launch "Operation Walanari" wich would consist of the following moves;
>The larger fleet with 2 battleships would move to place themselfs between the two lower islands and the direction that the invasion fleet seemed to have come from with operation code red, were all weapons and defences active and ready to go at a moments notice, both to treathen the invasion fleet with the battleships long range anti-ship missle payload (they curently have anti-ship missiles in 10 of their 15 VLS tubes) and to pose a problem for any logistics ships that is going to this hostile fleet.
>The 2 stealth UAVs would take to the air and start providing information and air targets for attacks.
>The 15 stealth fighters would form 5 wings of 3 aircraft each and use their advanced missile systems and stealth to pick apart any hostile aircrafts or missiles in the airzone of the two islands.
>The 3 Njord-Class Cruise missile Submarines together with launch sites in eastern Ostland would launch a barage of long range anti-ship cruise missiles, numbering about a hundred, at the invaiding fleet to get all of them away from the western side of the islands to clear a path for sending suplies.

>Then the  Argosian tribes there would be supplied with anit-air defences on the smaller island trough quick deliveries by Airheim SHH1-1C Sky Leviatan helicopter that would be guarded by Fighter escorts and stealth attack helicopers to prevent them from being shot down, these would bring in enough weapon systems to make 5 small mobile SAM teams were each would contain: 2x AAHAML-41 Module on Karlson 95MPT trucks, 5x AAAMS-3A Shield maidens on Karlson 85MPT truck with aditional mobile point defence systems to protect them together with "advisors" that would help the Argossians use the AA weapons effectivly.
There would also be sent Kangaroos with the  AAAMS-2B Valkyrie AA system and AC-4B AA2s to provide mobile AA defence for local forces, together with more weapons, vehilces and munitions to the Argossian defenders to replenish their losses including some more Iron Drake 2D tanks with ERA bricks for added protection.

Inn addition the stealth corvetes in Ostland and Nordland, aswell as the local attack submarines would be sendt to the small Nordiheimian island closest to all of this to provide defence for future events and operations.

The Nordiheimian could not only hope that this was all enough to save the Argossians on the two small islands from this hostile invasion and make the neceseary preparations to not only do further operations but most likely also to provide the local civilians with food, water and medical suplies as those were tings that would often get disrupted in a invasion and could turn out to be necesary.

[spoiler=A real Crazy Train][b]October 31, 3:00 am in the morning[/b]

A train rushes out of the station. Unlike most times this train isn't just carrying passengers, it's also carrying urgent cargo. Tanks, oil, guns, and the like that haven't made it to the search yet. And it's not just the cargo that's special, the passengers are special too. Troops and their families who are traveling to the port city of Wessernia, ready to say goodbye and to fight for the safety of Western View. As the train goes through the small town of Hartru, the unthinkable happens. An explosion in the back sends the train off the tracks, other explosion from all the military supplies and the oil extraction plant where the train crashed into cause more explosions. A fire breaks out burning the town of Hartru killing 21 people sleeping in the town, 65 in the oil plant, and 139 on board the train, including 12 kids. Those soldiers never even made it to the real battle field, instead them and their families are caught in a more tragic crossfire. Investigation begins and ends soon after they find pieces of a bomb as well as documentation from a Wessernian spy that it was a bomb, and they also found residue from a bomb. Now in the town of Hartru, there lies a monument to the 225 who died.[/spoiler]
[spoiler=The Deadliest Unicorns][b]Wessernia, Wessernian Stadium, December 19, 9:00 pm[/b]

The clock strikes 9:00, and then the fun begins. Smoke billows on to the stage, the music starts, and the lights flicker. The crowd cheers as they come on to the stage. There are 3 of them dressed in normal people clothes. One steps up to the drums. he places a bag next to him. Another steps up to an electronic panel. The last one steps up to the mic. Then: right as they're about to start the sound of jet engines fills the air. Nobody can see their confused faces through the smoke that won't stop coming. Then a group of F-4s fly over head. they do a loop de loop before anyone notices that the markings have the Wessernian symbol for hate which is also what Hatzur Zatsugi uses. A circle, then 4 lines that protrude from the circle, then another circle connecting all the lines together and closing the symbol. They turn back and point there noses towards the crowd. Then the chaos begins. They open fire, killing people who were oblivious to the danger. People scream not in excitement but in fear and rage. Then the others burst from behind. More planes all with the same marking, all with the same intension. To kill as many as they can. Behind the fighters are bombers who start dropping the bombs on so many innocent people. One lands with a thud, piercing the drum. The guys behind it runs for cover. His brothers also run off stage. They will not be spotted for 5 blocks, appearing at Station and 13th Street. As the bombs rain down on the stadium flattening it to piles of ruble, Hatzur Zatsugi gets ready to go live. The screens on the Central street building turn to all the same channel. He speaks. "People of Western View, if you aren't aware I have given you my 9th favor. I have destroyed your beloved Wessernian stadium and I have destroyed your beloved Deadly Unicorns. So John, would you like to negotiate?" The camera changes to a live feed of John Fredickson staring at the camera from his desk, intently watching the screen behind the camera.

"Hatzur, I deny negotiations. My people are proud and strong. They can take your weak, futile "10th favor" no matter what." Replies John Fredrickson.

"We will see who is stronger" Hatzur says before the broadcast ends and the screens go back to whatever they were the moment before.[/spoiler]
